ValidationRule.description: IF weekend hours are included in the time the type must be weekend, and no other hours can be entered against Monday - Friday
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Weekend") && ( pse__Monday_Hours__c >0 || pse__Tuesday_Hours__c>0 || pse__Wednesday_Hours__c >0 || pse__Thursday_Hours__c >0 || pse__Friday_Hours__c >0 )) || ( (pse__Saturday_Hours__c >0 || pse__Sunday_Hours__c >0 ) && (NOT(ISPICKVAL( Type__c, "Weekend")) && NOT(ISPICKVAL( Type__c, "Standby")) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If weekend hours are entered please ensure the Type is "Weekend" and no hours are entered for Monday-Friday
